title: Absorbed local events keep their fold order in the shared ledger
findings_note: s338 gate 2026-10-17: the reviewer reproduced on base that _absorb copies local events in file order, so a child step written in the same second as its parent from another checkout lands ahead of the parent and the shared ledger reads as corrupt
boundary: **Not in this slice:** changing the ledger format, deduplicating repeat copies (the absorbed count), or the fallback file location.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `relay-run` absorbs a checkout's local fallback events into the shared ledger from `Ledger.append_shared` and `relay_run_end` (s337, s340, s338). `_absorb` appends the copied events in the local file's order. The s338 reviewer reproduced a case on main before s338: a child step and its parent written in the same second from different checkouts are copied child first, and the shared ledger then fails to fold (`corrupt`). A relay run that crosses checkouts can therefore break `relay-run list` for every run in the ledger.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/ops.py`, `_absorb`: sort the events it copies into fold order (time, then the rank `relayrun.fold` uses) before appending.
- `tests/test_relay_run.py`; `CHANGELOG.md` under Fixed.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - `test_Absorb_ChildSameSecondAsParent_SharedLedgerFolds`: a parent step in one checkout's local file and its child in another, same timestamp; after absorb, `relay-run list` reads the run with the child under its parent.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Reproduce with the test above and watch it go red (`corrupt`).
2. Sort the copied events with the key the fold uses; keep the other absorb paths unchanged.
3. CHANGELOG; mutation-check (copy in file order again; sort by time only, if rank matters).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
